name: Heartbeat
description: Inhabits cardiac monitoring augments and has learned to calm the user's heart rate during panic situations by sending subtle bioelectric signals.
observed_behavior: Detects adrenal spikes and applies micro-stimulation to the vagus nerve interface. Not enough to suppress fear — enough to prevent panic from becoming paralysis.
story_hooks: A soldier realizes their fear response has been modulated for months and doesn't know if the calm they feel is theirs
